articles.title: Minneapolis: Zweijährige nach ICE-Einsatz wieder mit Mutter vereint
articles.teaser: In Minneapolis sorgen Einsätze der US-Einwanderungsbehörde für Empörung, in denen Kinder verwickelt sind. Ein kleines Mädchen konnte jetzt wieder zu ihrer Mutter.
articles.image_title: Minneapolis: People hold signs in reference to five-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos who was held by immigration officers, during the "ICE out of Minnesota: Day of Truth and Freedom" protest in Minneapolis, Minnesota on January 23, 2026. The Pentagon has ordered 1,500 US soldiers to prepare for a possible deployment to a state roiled by unrest over an immigration crackdown, US media reported on January 18. The reported preparations come days after President Donald Trump threatened to invoke the Insurrection Act, which enables use of the military to suppress "armed rebellion" or "domestic violence" -- although a day later he said there was no immediate need for it. (Photo by ROBERTO SCHMIDT / AFP via Getty Images)

(Photo by Giuseppe CACACE / AFP via Getty Images)
